jobDescription: The instant payments gateway connects the bank's core systems to the national instant payment scheme. The Integration Engineer operates the gateway in production: has released gateway changes into the live scheme connection, holds a place on the production support rota for payment incidents, watches live message throughput and rejection rates, coordinates scheme certification test windows with the scheme operator, and documents integration boundaries. Simulator and certification work is expected, but live operation of the connection is the core of the role.
requirements: Has released gateway changes into the live scheme connection and carried production payment incidents.
Holds a place on the production support rota and watches live message throughput and rejection rates.
Coordinates scheme certification test windows with the scheme operator and records own responsibility boundaries.
Builds and tests scheme message adapters against the scheme's certification simulator with a documented test evidence pack.
Documents integration limitations and hand-over conditions for each release candidate.

evidence.text: Built and tested the scheme message adapters for the instant payments gateway in the bank's test environment and the scheme's certification simulator, running the 412 certification test cases against the simulator across three certification cycles.
Coordinated the certification test windows with the scheme's certification desk and kept the test window log and the defect list for each cycle.

The live scheme connection, the production releases and the production support rota were held by the payments operations engineering team; my changes reached them through the release review, and I held no production access.

Wrote the test evidence pack submitted for scheme certification and the hand-over notes for each release candidate, listing the simulator's known differences from the scheme and the open items for operations.
Roughly three years on the gateway programme covered adapter development, simulator testing, certification window coordination, test evidence packs and hand-over notes.
Work sample: the test evidence pack for certification cycle three with the simulator's run identifiers and the defect list, and the hand-over notes for release candidate seven.

Recruiter screen: candidate said he 'took the gateway live on the scheme' and 'sits on the payments pager'; asked when he last handled a live payment incident, he described a simulator rejection during certification and said the operations engineers 'own the live side'.

Hiring manager pre-read: the recruiter's summary says 'production instant payments engineer, released to the live scheme'; the head of payments engineering wants someone who has released to the live scheme and carried production incidents, so the packet must say who did what in which environment.

followUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate has ever held production access or a support rota place for the gateway, and which live incident he handled.
